description: Agent full backup kit. The complete 1:1 backup methodology: root mapping for skills, knowledge, and agents folders, recursive inventory with per-folder counts and bytes, a secrets screen that reports hits by path and pattern only, byte-identical staging, a manifest with per-file sizes and checksums, a six-check verification pass, and a restore-rehearsal protocol. One call returns the full kit; the buyer's agent builds and verifies the archive itself. Price: $8.00 per call, paid in USDC on Base mainnet over x402; an unpaid call answers HTTP 402 with the exact machine-readable payment terms.
